## Circle Internet Group (CRCL) `[Internet & Platforms]`
- Wells Fargo analyst Cassie Chan maintained a **Buy** rating and a **$115 price target** on Circle in a report published Thursday, October 15 at 06:50 ET; the prior closing price was **$79.55**. (Business Insider, Oct 15 06:50 ET)[6]
- Citi included Circle among its **two highest-conviction digital-asset picks**, maintained a **Buy** rating, and set a **$243 price target**, versus a quoted price of **$83.87**. (Investing.com, Oct 15, time not stated)[2]
- Citi cited Circle’s Arc mainnet, launched September 16, which had accumulated approximately **$560 million in DeFi total value locked**, more than **$510 million in stablecoin supply**, and approximately **$500,000 in transaction fees** during its first week. (Investing.com, Oct 15, time not stated)[2]
- Circle traded as high as **$86.21** and at **$86.015** during Thursday trading, compared with a prior close of **$79.55**; approximately **9,991,660 shares** had traded at the report’s publication. (MarketBeat, Oct 15, time not stated)[1]
- Bitcoin rose back to approximately **$82,000** after trading below **$80,000**, while CRCL was reported up **6.7%** during the session. (CoinDesk, Oct 15 17:00 ET)[5]
- Standard Chartered’s October 14 note said USDC faced competition from Tether in emerging-market savings, identified Circle’s **50/50 Coinbase revenue-share agreement** as potentially “untenable” after changes in yield sharing, and said a **200-basis-point decline** in three-month Treasury-bill yields would remove a large portion of reserve income. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 14, time not stated)[7]
- Circle’s consensus target was reported at **$97.82**, with an average rating of **Hold**; the stock’s **50-day moving average was $85.36** and its **200-day moving average was $86.69**. (MarketBeat, Oct 15, time not stated)[1]
- No separately dated after-hours or pre-market catalyst for Friday, October 16 through **02:03 ET** was identified in the available results.
